description: Change of use from Funeral Parlour (Class E) to General Industrial (Car Mechanics - Servicing, Brakes, Exhaust, and Tyres) (Class B2) and Retail Car Parts Sales (Class E); alterations to boundary treatment (Retrospective)
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The
development results in unacceptable impacts upon the amenities of residential
properties in terms of noise, general disturbance and air quality. No supporting
technical information relating to noise, air, fumes, dust control and waste
handling and management has been submitted by the applicant to otherwise demonstrate
that adequate measures are in place to prevent adverse impacts. The development
therefore fails to comply with Policies D13, D14&nbsp; and SI 1 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy
GR1(Part C) of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The
vehicle circulation, parking and manoeuvring areas for the retention of the car
repair, servicing, tyre fitting and MOT business, alongside the partial retail
sales element of spare auto parts, are inadequate and the application site does
not provide suitable front/side yard to adequately serve the operations. The
development results in harmful impact upon highway safety and is found to be
contrary to Policies M2 and M3 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041), Policy T6
of the London Plan (2021) and relevant highways provisions of the National
Planning Policy Framework (2024) as per Paragraph 116.&nbsp;<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">By reason of the lack of provision of bicycle storage
to adequately serve the development, the development would fail to </span>contribute
to sustainable transport objectives, contrary to the <span lang="EN-US" style="">National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy T5
of the London Plan (2021), and Policies M1 and M2 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</span><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">By
virtue of the nature of the land use and lack of internal and external space to
appropriately serve the needs of the development, the development fails to
achieve a high standard of layout, negatively impacting the character and
appearance of the local area. As such, the development fails to comply with the
objectives of Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy GR1 of the Harrow
Local Plan (2021-2041).&nbsp;<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>
